headline: Pakistan Power Regulator Nepra Increases Industrial Tariff to Rs25.30 per Unit
summary: Pakistan's energy regulator Nepra revised the national industrial power tariff up to Rs25.30 per unit despite dissent from two board members. Consumers will pay an additional Rs2.37 per unit fuel cost adjustment.
why: Nepra sets utility tariffs in Pakistan; energy price hikes raise manufacturing costs for key export industries like textiles.

impacts.name: Pakistani Industrial Sector
impacts.why: Higher electricity tariffs increase input costs for manufacturers and export-oriented industrial units.
